definition: Vocaloid 6 is a singing vocal synthesizer application developed by Yamaha Corporation.
details: The successor to Vocaloid 5 in the Vocaloid series, it is the first to incorporate machine learning, branded as Vocaloid:AI.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Vocaloid 6 — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
